name: Question 2
problem: Find a basis of the null space of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
To find a basis of $\text{Null}(A),$ we need to solve the equation $Ax=0$ and express the solution as a linear combination of linearly independent vectors. Those vectors form a basis of $\text{Null}(A).$

The given matrix is already in row echelon form. So, the equation $Ax=0$ corresponds to the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=0 \\ {x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=0\end{aligned}\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=-9{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{2}=-3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are basic variables corresponding to the pivot columns ($1$st and $2$nd) and ${x}_{3}$ is a free variable corresponding to the non-pivot column. Therefore, if $x\in \text{Null}(A),$ then

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-9{x}_{3} \\ -3{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]={x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}],
$$

where ${x}_{3}\in R.$ This implies that

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}
$$

is a basis of $\text{Null}(A)$ since it is a linearly independent set and its vectors generate the $\text{Null}(A).$

Question 2
?

Find a basis of the null space of the matrix A=[1−23013].

a
B={[931],[311]}
b
B={[−3−11]}
c
B={[−9−31]}
d
B={[−3−91]}
e
B={}
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

To find a basis of Null(A), we need to solve the equation Ax=0 and express the solution as a linear combination of linearly independent vectors. Those vectors form a basis of Null(A).

The given matrix is already in row echelon form. So, the equation Ax=0 corresponds to the following system:

{x1−2x2+3x3=0x2+3x3=0⟹{x1=−9x3x2=−3x3

Here, x1 and x2 are basic variables corresponding to the pivot columns (1st and 2nd) and x3 is a free variable corresponding to the non-pivot column. Therefore, if x∈Null(A), then

[x1x2x3]=[−9x3−3x3x3]=x3[−9−31],

where x3∈R. This implies that

B={[−9−31]}

is a basis of Null(A) since it is a linearly independent set and its vectors generate the Null(A).
